name: ghostwire
description: GhostWire — Self-hosted VPN toolkit with a slick web UI. WireGuard-based, runs on Android (Termux), Linux, Windows, macOS — one Node.js runtime, zero build step.

scripts.check: node --check bin/ghostwire.js && node --check src/engine.js && node --check src/server.js && node --check src/qr.js && node --check src/util.js && node --check scripts/release.js

dependencies-meta.qrcode: SVG/PNG QR code generation for the web UI and API

dependencies-meta-note: Only runtime dep is qrcode; everything else is Node stdlib so it runs anywhere Node runs (Termux included).
